r12-command-without-time-cap.hint: Rule 12: every command you run needs a time ceiling (timeout N ...). A command without one is how a run hangs at 3am.

r13-validation-network-commit-together.hint: Rule 13: split local validation, the network call and the commit into separate steps, and check each one before the next.

r16-recurring-failure-becomes-a-rule.hint: Rule 16: this failure already happened before. Do not retry the same approach; change the approach or name the mechanism that would stop it.

r25-dry-run-before-store-write.hint: Rule 25: run the same command as a dry-run first and read its output before you write to the data store.

r26-absence-only-when-proven.hint: Rule 26: do not claim something is absent from a partial search. Search the whole scope, or say exactly what you searched.

r42-long-job-outside-dispatch-is-orphan.hint: Rule 42: a long-running job started outside the dispatcher has no watchdog. Run it in the foreground with a timeout, or do not start it.

r45-feedback-extractor-reads-produced-fi.hint: Rule 45: the feedback extractor reads fields you are not producing. Write the fields the spec names, with those exact names.

r46-oracle-command-line-has-backticks.hint: Rule 46: the oracle command line must be raw text with no backticks; the shell substitutes them before the check runs.

r47-control-files-stay-outside-workdir.hint: Rule 47: never create, touch or delete stop, pause or interrupt files. They belong to the orchestrator, not to the workdir.

r48-in-place-edit-of-live-bash.hint: Rule 48: do not edit a bash script a live run still executes. Write a temp file and mv it over, or wait for the run to end.

r50-oracle-line-count-is-not-the-bar.hint: Rule 50: line count is not the bar. Do not pad; the oracle greps the content of each section.

r52-product-repo-is-not-client-workdir.hint: Rule 52: work only in the target workdir. The product repo is not a workdir and not a spec store.

r55-fallback-validated-in-the-chain.hint: Rule 55: a registry fallback must point at an id that exists and an endpoint that answers. Check both before you rely on it.

r56-service-oracle-starts-the-production.hint: Rule 56: a green unit test does not close a service sprint. Start the process with the production command and talk to it over HTTP.
